summary: Captures the desktop, a display, or a supported application/window into a TOP image for live screen sampling.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Continuously grab the screen contents while enabled.

key_params.name: activepulse
key_params.note: Grab a single frame when Active is off.

key_params.name: source
key_params.note: Desktop, display, or supported application source.

key_params.name: refreshsource
key_params.note: Refresh the source list after displays/windows change.

common_gotchas: Application/window capture is Windows-only in the official docs.
Refresh Sources after connecting displays or opening/closing application windows.
Delayed mode is faster but may fail on some systems, especially Optimus laptops.
Bottom uses bottom = 0, so crop coordinates need the screen-origin convention in mind.
key_concepts: Screen Grab converts the main screen output or a selected source into a TOP image.
Capture can run continuously with Active or grab a single frame with Active Pulse.
Source selection can target Full Desktop, a display, or an individual application on Windows.
The capture region is controlled by left/right/bottom/top bounds with per-edge unit selectors.
